title: Square-Root Profiles and Sharp Fourier Decay of Quasiperiodic Spectral Measures
summary: We study spectral measures of one-dimensional quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators. For subcritical Schrödinger operator with Diophantine frequency, we prove sharp measurable-set bounds, answering a question of Avila and Jitomirskaya \cite{AJ}; we prove optimal Fourier decay and the sharp decay order of the time-averaged quantum return probability, confirming a conjecture of Aloisio, Carvalho, and de Oliveira \cite{ACO} and a prediction of Zhong and Mosseri \cite{ZhongMosseri}.
